program: APPUI-01 - Windows 11 ARM64 Working App Visual Prototype

director_decision.phase_1_stage_rule: Map the Stage functional/interface envelope before freezing surrounding layout, but do not open new Stage visual-design work during Phase 1.
director_decision.stage_theme_rule: The Stage remains dark in both Light and Dark application themes.
director_decision.design_residency: Design work remains in Ensemble-Website and authenticated Drive; Ensemble-Project is read-only architecture/product/runtime input.

sources_checked.engineering_program_state: E0-D blocked; post-E0 product-runtime architecture Phase D not yet frozen.

audit_pass_1_findings: Current APPUI continuity still described Stage rendering as parallel with UI-layout work, conflicting with the Director's newer sequential three-phase decision.

The proposed Stage envelope risked treating E0-only pipeline states such as Accepted/Rejected/Alternate Take as required product-facing controls even though final Take/rehearsal UX remains a later product-runtime decision.

An exact final Stage control inventory cannot yet be frozen because Engineering Phase D still owns unresolved Scene lifecycle, consequence review, Presentation Perspective, branching/Another Take/Rehearsal minimums and minimum Stage semantics.
The earlier Stage-proper versus Stage-workspace split was too coarse for reliable layout allocation.
The phase plan lacked explicit exit criteria and a mandatory Engineering architecture re-sync gate before Stage visual design begins.
repairs: Make the three phases sequential; Stage visual work no longer runs in parallel with Phase 1.
Use a Stage Interface Envelope in Phase 1 to reserve semantic capacity without choosing final Stage controls or visual behavior.
Classify requirements by authority/certainty so E0 implementation detail cannot harden into product UI accidentally.
Use four interface layers: app shell, live-workspace frame, Stage field, and transient/deep task surfaces.
Add explicit Phase 1 exit criteria and an Engineering Phase-D re-sync gate before Phase 2.

stage_interface_envelope.purpose: Prevent Phase 1 from producing a shell that later lacks room for required live-production semantics, without prematurely designing the Stage.

layers.L0_APP_SHELL: Production/application scope, durable navigation, app-level settings/help/diagnostics.
layers.L1_LIVE_WORKSPACE_FRAME: Scene/context anchors, semantic status, contextual commands, inspector host and supporting live-workspace information.
layers.L2_STAGE_FIELD: The dark theatrical field where persistent Characters, presence, relationship/attention and performed action remain primary.
layers.L3_TRANSIENT_OR_DEEP_SURFACES: Intervention, Character-bounded performance, causal/history inspection, consequence review, capability explanation and other task-duration surfaces.

A_CURRENT_DESIGN_BASELINE: dark Stage in both app themes
current frozen five-Character Stage composition as the active visual baseline, not a product-wide cast-cardinality law
one cone/presence carrier per displayed Character in the current baseline
truthful state separation and listening presence
creator action does not occupy Character cones
B_PRODUCT_SEMANTIC_MUST_REPRESENT: persistent Production and current Scene context
current action, dialogue, silence or refusal without chat-transcript dominance
current Director attention/opportunity and relationship salience when materially relevant, without freezing its visual treatment
current Presentation Perspective when disclosure materially differs
provisional/non-effective versus effective/accepted material distinction where applicable
truthful capability/unavailable state when it blocks an action
context and causal inspection without silently mutating Production truth
C_UX_OPEN_OR_PHASE_D_DEPENDENT: displayed Character-count adaptation beyond the current frozen five-Character visual baseline
exact Scene lifecycle controls and state labels
Another Take, branching and Rehearsal minimums if any
D_INTERNAL_E0_NOT_DEFAULT_UI: RunId, StateHash, content hashes and orchestration identifiers
provider-attempt internals except where later diagnostics deliberately expose them

phase_1.name: APPLICATION_UI_ARCHITECTURE_AND_LAYOUT
work: Complete the Stage Interface Envelope first.
Synthesize current app architecture with recovered UI-layout evidence without inheriting obsolete Studio/Stage/Archive navigation literally.
Design task-dependent Production, live-workspace, deep-inspection and Character-bounded compositions in co-equal Light/Dark shells.
Cover wide, medium and narrow/adaptive behavior plus keyboard/focus/accessibility reading order.
Exercise empty, loading, unavailable, historical, provisional/effective and selected-entity states.
Keep PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 as the Stage placeholder/baseline; create no new Stage visual language.
exit_criteria: Every A/B Stage-envelope requirement has a coherent home or transition without forcing a final C-class control.
Representative functional states work without information-architecture redesign in both Light and Dark themes.
Primary work surface, inspector, commands and semantic status remain task-dependent rather than one fixed dashboard grid.
Recovered layout inspiration improves hierarchy/density without reviving obsolete product modes.
A fresh Engineering architecture read finds no product-semantic change that invalidates the layout envelope.

phase_2.name: STAGE_AND_LIVE_PRODUCTION_EXPERIENCE
phase_2.entry_gate: Phase 1 exit criteria pass and Engineering architecture is fresh-reconciled.
work: Design the live Stage experience itself: Character presence, attention, relationship, performed action, silence/listening, intervention response, live text support, consequence emergence and motion/state transitions.
Use recovered presence/spotlight/monumental-space studies as inspiration without promoting them as authority.
Preserve product semantics and accessibility while refining or explicitly succeeding current Stage visual authority through the normal Design process.
phase_2.change_rule: Phase 2 may request evidence-driven Phase 1 layout adjustments, but may not casually reopen shell/navigation architecture for aesthetic preference.

phase_3.name: KYMAEAN_DESIGN_LANGUAGE_INTEGRATION
phase_3.entry_gate: Application layout and Stage/live-production experience are sufficiently stable.
work: Integrate refined material/surface language, identity accents, final functional icon treatment, micro-interactions, trace/history treatments, transitions and other secondary visual expression inside the proven framework.
Use recovered brand/material/threshold/trace explorations as inspiration while respecting current app-icon, CPS, accessibility and product authority.
phase_3.change_rule: Phase 3 must not alter information architecture merely to accommodate decoration; architectural changes require a demonstrated functional defect.

architecture_resync_rule: Fresh-read Ensemble-Project at the Phase 1 freeze boundary and again before any Phase 2 Stage-control hardening. If Engineering Phase D promotes new product semantics, update the envelope first; do not infer UI from E0 internals.

recursive_audit.remaining_irreducible_boundary: Exact final Stage controls cannot be frozen until post-E0 product-runtime architecture resolves the relevant Phase D questions; Phase 1 therefore freezes capacity and relationships, not those controls.

supersession: This decision supersedes only the prior wording that Stage visual rendering continues in parallel with APPUI layout work. Co-equal Light/Dark shells, invariant dark Stage, Design/Engineering repository separation and deferred secondary ornament remain active.
